profile: Fractions normalized by the exact projected full width, not image crop width. 127/1668,1534/1668,1574/1668.
ease: Cubic smoothstep for long thickness and brightness segments; linear short right segment.
color: Exact112 step1-calibration (Color B), no new color fit.
chosen_baseline: 112 c1-w1 for each of four cases; adoption is review preference, not retrospective strict score acceptance.
integration: Unmodified positive-area pixel rule, full pixel normalization. Two moments retain alpha and alpha times brightness reduction. No occupancy renormalization.
support: Retained pixel source guide must be finite for all new nonzero-alpha pixels.
visual_review: One fixed candidate with original reference and chosen baseline comparisons. No score optimization.
startup: Host python3 unavailable before protocol creation; no files or numerical body ran. Setup used existing node and approved Python bundle.
